- NJ-GDL-D-FOOTNOTE — placement of the age-twenty-one footnote marker on the GDL restriction chart (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- NJ-GDL-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NJ-GDL-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
